title: Deleting one project's kept branch also drops another project's same-named branch
what: After a kept branch is deleted in one project, keptAfter removes every pending item with that branch name, so another project's same-named branch disappears from the notice and can no longer be deleted there.
expected: Only the item whose own project reports the delete leaves the list; the other project's same-named branch stays.

test.name: [T2-F01] deleting a kept branch in one project keeps the same-named branch of another project on the list
